title: Calendar कभी खाली नहीं होगा
subtitle: Limited waqt mein selection, duty, attention aur result se thoda distance
credit: Yeh Oliver Burkeman ki finitude aur time-management thinking, aur Bhagavad Gita ke karma, detachment aur duty ke principles se inspired independent Hinglish adaptation hai.
sources: Intellectual base: finitude and attention philosophy, outcome bias and perceived control research, role conflict, caregiving and time-poverty research. Religious ideas ko interpretive lens ki tarah use kiya gaya hai, empirical proof ki tarah nahi. Saare characters aur scenes fictional hain.
